scopeNotes.read: Required for meter queries such as checking balance and usage.
scopeNotes.control: Required for meter switching and for voice payments. Voice payments additionally require 2FA (two-factor authentication) confirmation before any payment is executed.

notes: The 'control' scope is required for voice payments in addition to meter switching.
Voice payments additionally require 2FA (two-factor authentication) confirmation as part of the secure payment confirmation flow.
